label: Select each Agent current Session
summary: select newest open Session by (createdAt DESC, id DESC)

execute.description: select newest open Session by (createdAt DESC, id DESC)
execute.sql:
UPDATE "agent" SET "currentSessionId" = (
  SELECT "id" FROM "agentSession"
  WHERE "agentSession"."agentId" = "agent"."id"
    AND "agentSession"."status" = 'open'
  ORDER BY "agentSession"."createdAt" DESC, "agentSession"."id" DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
WHERE "agent"."status" IN ('spawning', 'alive')

label: Close non-current Agent Sessions
summary: close open Sessions not selected as current

execute.description: close open Sessions not selected as current
execute.sql:
UPDATE "agentSession" SET "status" = 'closed'
WHERE "agentSession"."status" = 'open'
  AND (
    NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM "agent" WHERE "agent"."id" = "agentSession"."agentId"
    )
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM "agent"
      WHERE "agent"."id" = "agentSession"."agentId"
        AND "agent"."status" IN ('dormant', 'retired')
    )
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM "agent"
      WHERE "agent"."id" = "agentSession"."agentId"
        AND "agent"."currentSessionId" IS NOT "agentSession"."id"
    )
  )
